title: Progress on Porous Media Research
summary: Progress on Porous Media Research - Fundamentals and Applications distills tomorrow’s energy and material revolutions into one elegant volume, delivering quantum-level radiative transfer models for solar-driven biomass valorization, precision solutions for multiphase MHD flows and poroelasticity, and field-proven tools from airborne aquifer mapping to supercritical polymer foaming and sol-gel electrocatalysts, while offering quantitative roadmaps for flow-boiling intensification, combustion control, and sustainable scale-up that empower students, researchers, and engineers alike to transform geothermal depths into power, biodegradable implants into medicine, and porous matter into the decisive lever for cleaner energy, safer water, and a programmable world.
